events.text: why is the super bowl always on a sunday in february? used to be january right

It moved because the NFL season got longer.
- Through the 2001 season the game was usually in late January.
- The 9/11 postponement pushed the 2002 game into February, and later schedule changes kept it there.
- In 2021 the league went from a 16- to a 17-game regular season, adding a week, which locked it into the second Sunday of February.
- Sunday is the TV choice: the biggest audience of the week, and Monday travel for fans.

how long to boil eggs for jammy yolks? Leo wants ramen eggs tomorrow

6 and a half minutes from a rolling boil, straight from the fridge, then into ice water.
- 6 min gives a runnier centre, 7 min a fudgy one.
- Lower them in gently with a spoon so they don't crack.
- For ramen eggs, peel and marinate in equal parts soy sauce, mirin and water (plus a little sugar) for 4 to 12 hours.

how does curling scoring work? Leo is glued to the olympics

Only one team scores per end: whoever has the stone closest to the button (centre) gets a point for each of their stones closer than the other team's best stone.
- A stone must be touching the house (the rings) to count.
- A game is usually 10 ends (8 in mixed doubles); most points wins.
- The team that scores throws first next end, so teams with the last-stone advantage (the hammer) sometimes 'blank' an end on purpose to keep it.
- Kid version for Leo: it's like shuffleboard on ice, closest rocks to the bullseye win.

where does the word 'sprint' in agile come from? Leo asked

It comes from Scrum, which borrowed it from rugby and running.
- Scrum itself is named after the rugby scrum, from a 1986 Harvard Business Review paper by Takeuchi and Nonaka about teams moving the ball together.
- Jeff Sutherland and Ken Schwaber formalized Scrum in the 1990s and called each short, fixed work cycle a 'sprint': a burst of focused effort with a clear finish line, then a rest and a look back.
- For Leo: a sprint is when the team picks a few jobs and races to finish them in two weeks, then high-fives and picks the next ones.
